card.name: Partway through lab and drug terms
card.fires_on: Responds partway through a longer medical word or number, such as inside a drug or lab term, or at the start of a decimal. The next piece of the word or figure is still to come.

modes.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split-up drug, cell or condition name.
